description: This file declares the interface for the IOOpSPMDExpander class used in TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR expansions, specifically for handling distribution expansion of IO operations like tf.WriteSummary.
external_methods: llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: IOOpSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class responsible for expanding and computing layouts for SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) distributed IO operations in TensorFlow's MLIR framework.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands a given MLIR operation for distributed execution, handling the specifics of IO operations.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the output layouts based on input layouts for the operation, going forward in the data flow.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the input layouts needed to produce the specified output layouts for the operation, going backward.
